name: progress
title: Progress
description: A horizontal bar showing how much of something is done: `role="progressbar"` with its value announced, `value` from 0 to `max` (100 by default) as shadcn's, clamped. `label` names it; `valueLabel` reads the value in words. With no value, a third of the track sweeps across it, and holds still in the middle under reduced motion.
